AlarmDescription: Alert 6 of 6. No AWS Backup job for the RDS database completed in the last 26 hours. A dead-man's switch: AWS Backup only reports non-zero counts, so silence is breaching. Needs the daily AWS Backup rule from docs/PRODUCTION_OPERATIONS.md (RDS automated backups publish no metric). 26 h = the daily cadence plus the backup rule's minimum one-hour start window, plus an hour of slack. Runbook: docs/PRODUCTION_OPERATIONS.md, Monitoring > First response > Backup missing.
